svg.title: Kolmo compression ratio and round-trip file throughput
svg.text: Kolmo file compression across levels 1–9 and Ultra
Vertical axis: original ÷ compressed bytes. Horizontal axis: complete encode + decode throughput (MB/s, log scale).
Each pair is one level. Hover over a point for details.
Warm-cache Apple M5, seven scored rounds per cell, randomized order with same-binary controls. Shared host; timings are descriptive.
